title: Learning clarinet in Los Angeles; Chris Kelly hires him on saxophone
summary: Manetta recalls being hired extra by Chris Kelly's band, then how a Los Angeles friend taught him clarinet from a method book until his mother's illness brought him home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
